blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.24
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.24

blocks.text: मात्रास्वप्रत्ययसन्धाने नष्टस्य पुनरुत्थानम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] मात्रास्वप्रत्ययसन्धाने नष्टस्य पुनरुत्थानम्

blocks.text: Mātrāsvapratyayasandhāne naṣṭasya punarutthānam.
blocks.directed: Mātrāsvapratyayasandhāne naṣṭasya punarutthānam.

blocks.text: Through uniting the objects of experience with awareness of one’s true Self, what was lost arises again.
blocks.directed: Through uniting the objects of experience with awareness of one’s true Self, what was lost arises again.

blocks.text: You Forgot You Were Śiva. Here’s How to Remember Without Running Back to Your Cushion.
blocks.directed: You Forgot You Were Śiva. Here’s How to Remember Without Running Back to Your Cushion.

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.text: This is one of the most practically significant instructions in the entire work.
blocks.directed: This is one of the most practically significant instructions in the entire work.

blocks.text: Because we’ve just seen how the recognition of turya can become interrupted by ordinary mental activity.
blocks.directed: Because we’ve just seen how the recognition of turya can become interrupted by ordinary mental activity.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta says it can be restored.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta says it can be restored.

blocks.text: But the method is fascinating.
blocks.directed: But the method is fascinating.

blocks.text: It’s not necessarily a withdrawal from the objects of experience.
blocks.directed: It’s not necessarily a withdrawal from the objects of experience.

blocks.text: It’s a transformation of the relationship between those objects and consciousness.
blocks.directed: It’s a transformation of the relationship between those objects and consciousness.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack the compound.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack the compound.

blocks.text: Mātrā — measure or measured object; here the objects of cognition.
blocks.directed: Mātrā — measure or measured object; here the objects of cognition.

blocks.text: Sva — one’s own.
blocks.directed: Sva — one’s own.

blocks.text: Pratyaya — cognition, apprehension, recognition.
blocks.directed: Pratyaya — cognition, apprehension, recognition.

blocks.text: Sandhāna — joining, connecting, bringing into union.
blocks.directed: Sandhāna — joining, connecting, bringing into union.

blocks.text: Naṣṭasya — of that which was lost.
blocks.directed: Naṣṭasya — of that which was lost.

blocks.text: Punarutthānam — rising again, reappearance, restoration.
blocks.directed: Punarutthānam — rising again, reappearance, restoration.

blocks.text: The critical term is svapratyaya.
blocks.directed: The critical term is svapratyaya.

blocks.text: In Kṣemarāja’s interpretation, it concerns the recognition of the true I-consciousness.
blocks.directed: In Kṣemarāja’s interpretation, it concerns the recognition of the true I-consciousness.

blocks.text: Not the ordinary individual ego.
blocks.directed: Not the ordinary individual ego.

blocks.text: Not merely thinking your personal name.
blocks.directed: Not merely thinking your personal name.

blocks.text: But awareness of the Self as the conscious reality underlying manifestation.
blocks.directed: But awareness of the Self as the conscious reality underlying manifestation.

blocks.text: And when the objects of experience are brought into relation with that recognition, the previously obscured bliss of turya reappears.
blocks.directed: And when the objects of experience are brought into relation with that recognition, the previously obscured bliss of turya reappears.

blocks.text: Now let’s understand the actual method.
blocks.directed: Now let’s understand the actual method.

blocks.text: A sound arises.
blocks.directed: A sound arises.

blocks.text: Ordinarily, you might simply follow the sound outward.
blocks.directed: Ordinarily, you might simply follow the sound outward.

blocks.text: You identify it.
blocks.directed: You identify it.

blocks.text: Judge it.
blocks.directed: Judge it.

blocks.text: React to it.
blocks.directed: React to it.

blocks.text: Construct a story around it.
blocks.directed: Construct a story around it.

blocks.text: But the practitioner can instead apprehend the sound through the recognition of consciousness.
blocks.directed: But the practitioner can instead apprehend the sound through the recognition of consciousness.

blocks.text: Not:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Not:

blocks.text: “This sound is a completely independent thing confronting a fundamentally separate subject.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “This sound is a completely independent thing confronting a fundamentally separate subject.”

blocks.text: But:
blocks.directed: [short pause] But:

blocks.text: “This sound is appearing within the luminous reality of consciousness.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “This sound is appearing within the luminous reality of consciousness.”

blocks.text: Now, be precise.
blocks.directed: Now, be precise.

blocks.text: The sound isn’t merely being imagined away.
blocks.directed: The sound isn’t merely being imagined away.

blocks.text: The object remains an object within the conventional structure of experience.
blocks.directed: The object remains an object within the conventional structure of experience.

blocks.text: But its ultimate metaphysical status changes.
blocks.directed: But its ultimate metaphysical status changes.

blocks.text: It is recognised as a manifestation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is recognised as a manifestation of consciousness.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja’s commentary is very explicit about this.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja’s commentary is very explicit about this.

blocks.text: He cites the Svacchandatantra, instructing the practitioner to investigate the supreme reality through whatever the eyes perceive, speech expresses, mind thinks, intellect determines or ego appropriates.
blocks.directed: He cites the Svacchandatantra, instructing the practitioner to investigate the supreme reality through whatever the eyes perceive, speech expresses, mind thinks, intellect determines or ego appropriates.

blocks.text: That’s an extraordinary list.
blocks.directed: That’s an extraordinary list.

blocks.text: Because it means the entire apparatus of ordinary cognition can become a field of recognition.
blocks.directed: Because it means the entire apparatus of ordinary cognition can become a field of recognition.

blocks.text: Seeing.
blocks.directed: Seeing.

blocks.text: Speaking.
blocks.directed: Speaking.

blocks.text: Thinking.
blocks.directed: Thinking.

blocks.text: Judging.
blocks.directed: Judging.

blocks.text: Even the activity of ego-appropriation.
blocks.directed: Even the activity of ego-appropriation.

blocks.text: The practitioner doesn’t have to begin by annihilating all these faculties.
blocks.directed: The practitioner doesn’t have to begin by annihilating all these faculties.

blocks.text: They can become occasions for investigating the conscious source.
blocks.directed: They can become occasions for investigating the conscious source.

blocks.text: And now comes an even more radical teaching.
blocks.directed: And now comes an even more radical teaching.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja cites further passages from the Svacchandatantra explaining that the yogi should recognise the supreme reality wherever the mind moves.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja cites further passages from the Svacchandatantra explaining that the yogi should recognise the supreme reality wherever the mind moves.

blocks.text: Wherever it goes.
blocks.directed: Wherever it goes.

blocks.text: Not only during meditation.
blocks.directed: Not only during meditation.

blocks.text: Not only inside a shrine.
blocks.directed: Not only inside a shrine.

blocks.text: Not only while repeating a mantra.
blocks.directed: Not only while repeating a mantra.

blocks.text: Wherever cognition occurs.
blocks.directed: Wherever cognition occurs.

blocks.text: And the explanation is profoundly nondual.
blocks.directed: And the explanation is profoundly nondual.

blocks.text: If the whole universe is understood as pervaded by Śiva, where can the mind actually go that is ultimately outside Śiva?
blocks.directed: If the whole universe is understood as pervaded by Śiva, where can the mind actually go that is ultimately outside Śiva?

blocks.text: That’s the point. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: That’s the point. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And now imagine this.
blocks.directed: And now imagine this.

blocks.text: You’re walking through a market.
blocks.directed: You’re walking through a market.

blocks.text: There’s a noise.
blocks.directed: There’s a noise.

blocks.text: You become distracted.
blocks.directed: You become distracted.

blocks.text: You start thinking about something that needs doing.
blocks.directed: You start thinking about something that needs doing.

blocks.text: A memory arises.
blocks.directed: A memory arises.

blocks.text: An emotion appears.
blocks.directed: An emotion appears.

blocks.text: Then you remember the teaching.
blocks.directed: Then you remember the teaching.

blocks.text: Instead of treating the thought as evidence that you’ve departed from some sacred reality, you investigate the consciousness in which it appears.
blocks.directed: Instead of treating the thought as evidence that you’ve departed from some sacred reality, you investigate the consciousness in which it appears.

blocks.text: The thought itself becomes an occasion for recognition.
blocks.directed: The thought itself becomes an occasion for recognition.

blocks.text: Not because every thought is automatically liberating.
blocks.directed: Not because every thought is automatically liberating.

blocks.text: But because the practitioner can recognise its manifestation within the conscious source.
blocks.directed: But because the practitioner can recognise its manifestation within the conscious source.

blocks.text: This is extraordinarily important.
blocks.directed: This is extraordinarily important.

blocks.text: Because otherwise spiritual practice can become a strange dualism.
blocks.directed: Because otherwise spiritual practice can become a strange dualism.

blocks.text: There’s the sacred state.
blocks.directed: There’s the sacred state.

blocks.text: And the ordinary state.
blocks.directed: And the ordinary state.

blocks.text: There’s meditation.
blocks.directed: There’s meditation.

blocks.text: And there’s life.
blocks.directed: And there’s life.

blocks.text: There’s Śiva.
blocks.directed: There’s Śiva.

blocks.text: And there’s everything that distracts me from Śiva.
blocks.directed: And there’s everything that distracts me from Śiva.

blocks.text: But if the world is Śiva’s own manifestation, that division cannot be ultimate.
blocks.directed: But if the world is Śiva’s own manifestation, that division cannot be ultimate.

blocks.text: The point is not to manufacture a private spiritual experience insulated from reality.
blocks.directed: The point is not to manufacture a private spiritual experience insulated from reality.

blocks.text: It’s to recognise reality through all its appearances.
blocks.directed: It’s to recognise reality through all its appearances.

blocks.text: And here we can see why Śāktopāya was so important.
blocks.directed: And here we can see why Śāktopāya was so important.

blocks.text: चित्तं मन्त्रः।
blocks.directed: [slowly] चित्तं मन्त्रः।

blocks.text: Cittaṃ mantraḥ.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Cittaṃ mantraḥ.

blocks.text: The mind is mantra.
blocks.directed: The mind is mantra.

blocks.text: Mental activity can become an instrument of recognition when its source is understood.
blocks.directed: Mental activity can become an instrument of recognition when its source is understood.

blocks.text: And now:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And now:

blocks.text: मात्रास्वप्रत्ययसन्धाने नष्टस्य पुनरुत्थानम्।
blocks.directed: [slowly] मात्रास्वप्रत्ययसन्धाने नष्टस्य पुनरुत्थानम्।

blocks.text: Through union between objects and true Self-awareness, what was lost returns.
blocks.directed: Through union between objects and true Self-awareness, what was lost returns.

blocks.text: Notice the structure.
blocks.directed: Notice the structure.

blocks.text: The practitioner has become distracted by objects.
blocks.directed: The practitioner has become distracted by objects.

blocks.text: But the objects themselves can become the means through which recognition is restored.
blocks.directed: But the objects themselves can become the means through which recognition is restored.

blocks.text: The supposed obstacle becomes the occasion for liberation.
blocks.directed: The supposed obstacle becomes the occasion for liberation.

blocks.text: The very cognition that previously sustained limitation can now disclose its source.
blocks.directed: The very cognition that previously sustained limitation can now disclose its source.

blocks.text: It’s extraordinary.
blocks.directed: It’s extraordinary.

blocks.text: Imagine somebody searching frantically for the door out of a room.
blocks.directed: Imagine somebody searching frantically for the door out of a room.

blocks.text: They examine every wall.
blocks.directed: They examine every wall.

blocks.text: Every corner.
blocks.directed: Every corner.

blocks.text: Every possible escape route.
blocks.directed: Every possible escape route.

blocks.text: Eventually, somebody points out that the wall they’ve been leaning against contains the door.
blocks.directed: Eventually, somebody points out that the wall they’ve been leaning against contains the door.

blocks.text: The door was not created by the discovery.
blocks.directed: The door was not created by the discovery.

blocks.text: But the relationship to the room changes completely.
blocks.directed: But the relationship to the room changes completely.

blocks.text: And that’s the kind of reversal being described.
blocks.directed: And that’s the kind of reversal being described.

blocks.text: The practitioner doesn’t have to escape from manifestation to find consciousness.
blocks.directed: The practitioner doesn’t have to escape from manifestation to find consciousness.

blocks.text: Manifestation itself can disclose consciousness.
blocks.directed: Manifestation itself can disclose consciousness.

blocks.text: And this is where Kṣemarāja’s interpretation becomes particularly beautiful.
blocks.directed: And this is where Kṣemarāja’s interpretation becomes particularly beautiful.

blocks.text: Recognition is recoverable through the very world that seemed to obscure it.
blocks.directed: Recognition is recoverable through the very world that seemed to obscure it.

blocks.text: But once that recognition becomes fully established, what happens to the yogi?
blocks.directed: But once that recognition becomes fully established, what happens to the yogi?

blocks.text: Apparently he becomes like Śiva.
blocks.directed: Apparently he becomes like Śiva.

blocks.text: Oh, excellent.
blocks.directed: Oh, excellent.

blocks.text: We’ve reached the promotion ceremony.
blocks.directed: We’ve reached the promotion ceremony.
